$ agentflow plugin remove ci-notify --yes
--- stdout
Removed ci-notify 0.2.0.
Deleted plugins.ci-notify from your personal settings.
--- stderr
Agentflow plugin.install: confirm (default)
Remove plugin ci-notify 0.2.0: "CI failure notifications"
  hash      sha256:<digest-5>
  deletes
    the installed copy of ci-notify 0.2.0
    the plugin's data directory, and everything the plugin stored in it
    plugins.ci-notify in your personal settings: whether it was enabled and its settings
! A running plugin is stopped when the console sees the change. Removing cannot be undone: add the plugin again to get it back.
